paths.risk: New project, enabled adapter or endpoint/policy transition can block or falsely fail before the configuration decision. Preserve no commit on failed readiness and unchanged current project/global state.
The actual R16 failure occurs on fresh physical generation before decision. Keep original deadline, empty-topic proof, epoch/ownership isolation, and no restore commit on timeout/invalid metadata.
Worker retries share project resources and epoch fences. A delayed readiness request must not adopt a retired topic, create duplicate delivery, starve Blue or publish a binding before checks pass.

changed_function_assumption: Planning assumes only Eventing.provision/readiness helpers and its owning normative specification/tests change. Recompute impact if request semantics, Eventing worker/filter/materialization, transport schemas, Scope/Resources or storage code also change.
